scope: Follow-on inode-phase census optimization only; not a gate on the current build or authority to replace its frozen helper.
finding: No filesystem identity/race defect found. Every alias and root is checked before/after the phase; full metadata includes ctime. Each verified device/inode is opened once with NOFOLLOW and fstat/path fences, streamed once for exact-size Git blob SHA1 and SHA256, and checked against expected OID/mode/link topology. All paths are rechecked after all reads, catching mutation of an earlier inode during a later read. The cache exists only within one call; a subsequent phase reads again.
independent_tests: Nine selected tiny new inode/race controls PASS in0.127seconds on CPU2/2GiB/120seconds, including growth, restored-mtime ABA, alias replacement, root drift, earlier-inode mutation, nofollow swap, unexplained links and per-phase reread. No baseline benchmark, real corpus scan, current helper validation, compiler, root, Docker, Git or network operation.
